entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape cover art for a 2D top-down mobile runner game. Perfectly orthographic straight-down view of a cute red ladybug racing upward along an enormous tree trunk. Three parallel moss-separated bark lanes run vertically with no convergence. The ladybug is in the lower third, small but bright and readable; ahead are crystal dew drops, a golden seed, a mushroom-covered tree knot and glowing amber resin, each clearly belonging to one of the three lanes. Bark grain and tiny leaves stream downward to suggest speed. Hand-painted children's storybook gouache and colored-pencil illustration, warm sunlight, lush moss green, chestnut bark, cyan dew and honey amber accents, energetic but uncluttered composition. Landscape 4:3. Critical constraints: no horizon, no sky, no vanishing point, no perspective convergence, no road, no car, no neon, no text, no title, no logo, no UI, no SVG.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: vertically scrolling game background texture for a 2D top-down mobile runner. Scene: an enormous old tree trunk viewed from a perfectly orthographic straight-down camera, the camera lens exactly perpendicular to the bark surface. The bark fills the frame from left to right, with three equal-width parallel climbing lanes separated by two thin irregular moss seams. Rich readable bark grain, shallow cracks, lichen and tiny leaf fragments provide strong downward motion texture. Soft out-of-focus forest foliage only at the extreme left and right edges. Hand-painted storybook gouache and colored-pencil rendering, warm chestnut bark, moss green, cream sunlight, the same playful woodland art direction as a premium children's adventure game. Composition: portrait 2:3, continuous vertical strip, top and bottom have matching texture density and lighting so the image can loop while scrolling. Critical constraints: absolutely no horizon, no sky, no visible tree crown, no vanishing point, no perspective convergence, no road, no receding paths, no characters, no obstacles, no collectibles, no text, no logo, no UI, no SVG, no empty flat areas. After generation, edit the image while preserving its palette, texture and three parallel moss seams: remove every circular knot, spiral burl, tree hole and ring-shaped bark mark that could be mistaken for a gameplay obstacle; replace them with long vertical grain and irregular shallow cracks, keeping the result loop-friendly.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: player sprite for a 2D top-down mobile runner. A single cute ladybug seen from a perfectly straight overhead camera, crawling upward toward the top of the canvas. Rounded red wing shell with black spots, small cream-and-dark-brown head visible at the top, six short animated-looking legs spread clearly to the sides, two tiny antennae pointing upward. Strong compact silhouette, symmetrical overhead anatomy, hand-painted storybook gouache and colored-pencil texture, warm cream highlights, thick organic dark-brown outline, matching premium woodland game art. Centered full body filling 68% of the canvas. No side view, no front-facing standing pose, no human-like body, no text, no UI, no frame, no shadow, no extra objects. Flat perfectly uniform pure magenta #FF00FF background. The magenta background was removed locally. For animation preparation, the six baked legs and feet were then removed deterministically from the alpha channel while preserving the original antennae, head, shell, spots, outline, texture, scale and placement; the final PNG contains no fixed legs.
